sources.title: Alaska Department of Fish and Game, Upper Cook Inlet commercial fisheries
sources.note: PRIMARY. More than 1,300 limited-entry drift and set gillnet salmon permits in Upper Cook Inlet, about 10 percent of every commercial salmon permit issued statewide. The fair-counterpoint anchor.

sourcing_note: Two confidence levels, labeled as such on screen. The machine-learning mechanism is independently reported twice by TechCrunch, two years apart, and the permit count is ADFG. Everything specific to Alaska traces to one PR-style trade write-up dated July 30th plus the company's own site, and every one of those appears on screen stamped COMPANY SAYS. As of this run's search no Alaska outlet and no fisheries trade outlet has covered it.
